summary: Independent adversarial review of the D-213 draft, run to refute. The subject is byte-intact at fbdd63e6… and mode 0444 at both start and end of review, measured at live HEAD 09b1c6cb with required-now 28 independently confirmed from file 08's condition-4 row. All 9 digests the draft cites recompute exactly, and the audit was extended one level deeper: all 27 sha256 leaves inside the recorded occupancy's own recordedInputs also recompute exactly against live bytes, with zero missing paths. Both Stage A verdicts are mode 0444, both pin the v4 subject at 0b4c25f4… in their custody blocks, both return ACCEPT with zero blockers and zero SHOULD-FIX, and both independently attest that the counterpart was not read. All 17 prompted attack lines were run and every one is REFUTED. Nine further probes of my own — the no-cell-edit branch boundary at D-170, Stage A version substitution, Stage A independence, v4 pin drift against live state, whether the V3-SF1 shared class was genuinely landed or merely narrated, the D-165/D-179/D-206 lineage attributions, the D-086 G14 provenance, the PASS-NO-SCOPE-EFFECT clause as a scope loophole, and an under-claiming summary gap — landed nothing. The Reversibility span parses to exactly 46 members equal to D-167..D-212 with D-168 present and no extraneous member. The draft records v4 and only v4; frozen v1, v2 and v3 are cited with correct digests and explicitly excluded as current. It is a gate-row draft and affirmatively declines to claim that D-056 gates 2 and 3 do not hold. Zero MUST-FIX, zero SHOULD-FIX.
decisionRule: CONSENT only if no MUST-FIX or SHOULD-FIX. Zero of each stands, therefore CONSENT.
